# East Anglian Sales LTD

> UK greeting card, giftware, and confectionery sales agency covering East Anglia. Founded by Dave Langdon (David Langdon). Member of the UK Greeting Card Association (GCA).

## Summary

East Anglian Sales LTD supplies independent retailers, garden centres, museums, and visitor attractions across Suffolk, Norfolk, Essex, Cambridgeshire, and Hertfordshire with wholesale greeting cards, gifts, display solutions, and confectionery ranges. Contact: Dave Langdon — phone 07709197915, email dave@easalesltd.co.uk. Based in Ipswich, Suffolk.

- [Home](https://www.easalesltd.co.uk/): Company overview and partner brands

- [Bespoke confectionery displays](https://www.easalesltd.co.uk/display-solutions/bespoke-confectionery-displays): Plastic-free sweets and confectionery displays (Cambridge Confectionery / Calico Cottage)
- [Temporary rep cover](https://www.easalesltd.co.uk/temporary-rep-cover): Cover for greeting card / gift territories
- [Contact](https://www.easalesltd.co.uk/contact): Phone, email, and visit request
- [Site index](https://www.easalesltd.co.uk/site-index): Full crawlable index of pages
- [Blog / press](https://www.easalesltd.co.uk/blog): Trade press coverage
